question: Create a volcano plot showing log2 fold change (x-axis) vs. -log10(p-value) (y-axis) for gene expression data. Highlight genes with |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05 in red. Annotate the top 5 most significant genes.

expected_output.guidelines: Volcano plot must show significantly differentially expressed genes (|log2FC| > 1, adj p < 0.05) highlighted in a distinct color and the 5 most significant genes annotated by name; axis labels, color scheme, and annotation offsets may differ.
